requirements.title: per-template fitness counts (per-replica cost, drift surfaces, coordinated-edit count)
requirements.description: Mechanizes the reference-pattern-fitness sub-lens counts for each registered template: per-replica line cost x replication factor, drift-surface count, comment-only-contract count, and the add/delete coordinated-edit walkthrough count. Surfaces numbers and flags candidates only; tiering/substrate decisions stay agentic.

validation.notes: API: fitness counts are deterministic against a frozen template fixture; target api/internal/convergence.
E2E: fitness scan over a registered template; target bas/cases/convergence.

requirements.title: gold-star reference health: stale-from-template, clean-on-all-tools, stability, breadth
requirements.description: Computes reference-scenario eligibility/health: stale-from-template (Generated date vs template last-commit), clean-on-all-tools (read from test-genie/scenario-auditor), >=60d stability (git age), and coverage breadth. Reads existing toolchain results; never re-runs them.

validation.notes: API: stale-from-template date comparison + eligibility verdict; target api/internal/convergence.
E2E: reference-health verdict over the gold-star reference.

requirements.title: convergence trend over dated fitness-audit records (the compounding proof)
requirements.description: `convergence trend` returns per-replica-cost and coordinated-edit-count over the dated fitness-audit records for a template, showing whether template fitness is improving over time — the compounding proof that template investment pays off across replicas.

validation.notes: API: trend series assembled from the dated fitness-audit index; target api/internal/convergence.
E2E: trend over >=2 dated audit points.
